title: ExtremeAdventures
description: ExtremeAdventures is a NeoForge mod for those who want long adventures, with experience
body:
ExtremeAdventures is a mod which completely overhauls the default minecraft experience, currently only in the overworld.

It adds new features like:
- New Ores (Ancient Fossil)
- Biomes and Woods (Poplar, Willow)
- Music disc (~~_surprise_~~)
- Villager type (Developer (trapped chest, items for game progressing))
- Paintings (~~_surprise_~~)
- Potion (Felix Felicis)

More things coming soon.
